name: Databricks Native Experimentation
overview: Run experiments in LaunchDarkly using data in your Databricks warehouse to power your results.
description: Enable LaunchDarkly's experimentation platform to read and analyze data from your Databricks warehouse
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: Project and environment
formVariables.description: This cannot be edited after this destination is saved.

formVariables.name: Databricks workspace host
formVariables.description: Enter the URL of your Databricks workspace. Raw host name is sufficient

formVariables.name: Warehouse HTTP path
formVariables.description: Enter the HTTP path of your Databricks SQL warehouse. Eg /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc123

formVariables.name: Personal Access token
formVariables.description: Personal Access Token (PAT), which should match the desired Data Export integration.

formVariables.name: Catalog name
formVariables.description: Provide the Unity catalog name where LaunchDarkly data will be stored

formVariables.name: Schema name
formVariables.description: Schema name where computed tables will be created

formVariables.name: Metrics database name
formVariables.description: Database where metric events are stored in Databricks

formVariables.name: Metrics schema name
formVariables.description: If not provided, access is granted to all schemas of the catalog entered above

formVariables.name: Recurring Task Id
formVariables.description: The task id of the scheduled work task for this integration
